title: Header of an owner feedback ADR
description: The JSON block that opens docs/adr/feedback/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>-<slug>-<4hex>.md, between the lines ```json and ```. The raw feedback, verbatim, is in the body under ## Observed. Written once, never edited: a correction is a new ADR that names this one in supersedes.

rule.description: What to repeat (good) or never do again (bad), as one imperative sentence.

scope.description: Tags an agent filters on: move:<slug>, weapon:<w>, tradition:<t>, area:anatomy, area:grip, area:locomotion, …

spec.description: Path of the move spec judged.

credits.description: Agents (or cultures) whose recommendation the verdict judges.

definition.description: A full move-constraints/v1 entry, so /anim-review can evaluate it.
